name: Ascendis Health Limited
summary: Ascendis Health Limited, a health and wellness company, manufactures and distributes healthcare products in South Africa, Cyprus, Spain, Hungary, Romania, and internationally. It operates through Consumer Health, Pharma, and Medical segments. The company offers body and skin products, as well as over-the-counter, and complementary and alternative consumer products; and supplies medical devices and consumables. It also exports its products to approximately 171 countries. Ascendis Health Limited was founded in 2008 and is based in Johannesburg, South Africa.
